title: Behavioral Pattern
measures: Which contributor pattern the student's sprint fits (Consistent deep contributor, Last-minute rusher, Reviewer or coordinator, Burst worker, Free rider, or none) and the multiplier that goes with it.
inputs: the Effort, Consistency and Collaboration scores
computation: Five rules from the proposal with fixed cut points (thresholds.json): modifiers inside the pattern's range, scaled by how far past the cut points the student is, capped to 0.80-1.20. A missing score is never replaced by 0: Collaboration not available means the Reviewer and full Free-rider rules cannot fire; a Free rider can still be decided from Effort and Consistency alone, with a milder modifier.
output_scale: A multiplier on the fused score, 0.80 to 1.20; 1.00 means no adjustment.
gates: Applied only when its inputs are final; during a sprint it is shown as a tendency, without a modifier.
Effort or Consistency missing: Unclassified, modifier 1.00.
validation: No instructor judgements exist. Against assistant-written labels (a pipeline check): accuracy 0.45, kappa 0.35 on 299 records; precision 0.72-0.88 when a rule fires, but Last-minute rusher never fires and Burst worker finds 4 of 65. Sensitivity to the cut points: 12-14% of patterns change for a shift of 0.05.
limits: The cut points are cohort quantiles of one course.
Effort-only Free rider applies a 5-10% reduction to students with almost no activity when their team did not review; a lecturer should look at these first.

warnings.Collaboration not available: The Reviewer and full Free-rider rules could not be tested.
warnings.effort alone: Free rider decided without a Collaboration score.

typical_problems.symptom: Free rider for a student who works outside Git
typical_problems.likely_cause: work not visible in the repository
